summary.text: Jordan Haire is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
A mental health counselor, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a Hamilton native.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Haire graduated from Badin High School, according to Ballotpedia, and her profession is listed as mental health counselor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked as a mental health counselor for 13 years.
Haire named affordability, fully funding public education, and being a voice for residents in Columbus as her key messages.
She listed education, healthcare, mental health, data center legislation, property taxes and affordability as the policy areas she is passionate about.
